allowed_bug_fixes.name: user_created runtime_snapshot NameError
allowed_bug_fixes.root_cause: The legacy /compare route's user_created branch referenced runtime_snapshot without ever defining it. The /run handler defines runtime_snapshot via resolve_runtime_snapshot_source(...); the /compare handler did not. This means the user_created path in /compare would raise NameError on first execution.
allowed_bug_fixes.fix: The service resolves the snapshot early in execute_compare_route via deps.resolve_runtime_snapshot_source(...) and uses it consistently. The user_created branch now receives a properly-resolved snapshot and builds ProjectInputs from it. SnapshotInputError is caught narrowly via deps.snapshot_input_error.
allowed_bug_fixes.verification: Phase 51C-1 xfail test_converted to passing: test_compare_user_created_path_resolves_runtime_snapshot_via_service. New test in 51C-2 suite: test_compare_service_resolves_runtime_snapshot_for_user_created.

allowed_bug_fixes.name: saved_state + active_scenario uses raw form values instead of resolved snapshot
allowed_bug_fixes.root_cause: The legacy /compare route's non-user_created branch checked runtime_snapshot and runtime_origin == saved_state but runtime_snapshot was never set in that code path (the resolver was never called for /compare). This means the saved_state + active_scenario path silently fell through to the form-driven schema build, using raw form values instead of the resolved snapshot.
allowed_bug_fixes.fix: The same early resolution (shown above) makes runtime_snapshot properly defined for ALL branches, including the saved_state + active_scenario path. The template-seeded branch now correctly calls build_projectinputs_from_snapshot(runtime_snapshot) when on the saved_state + active_scenario path.
allowed_bug_fixes.verification: Phase 51C-1 test updated: test_compare_route_references_undefined_runtime_snapshot -> test_compare_route_no_longer_references_undefined_runtime_snapshot (asserts route body no longer references runtime_snapshot as a free variable). New test in 51C-2 suite: test_compare_service_resolves_snapshot_for_saved_state_path + test_compare_service_saved_state_branch_uses_resolved_snapshot.

compare_service_api.public_entry_point: async def execute_compare_route(*, request, form, user, deps) -> CompareRouteOutcome

read_only_invariant.rationale: compare_service.py and the /compare route do NOT call any persistence / record_* helper. No record_compare_run (does not exist), no record_workspace_runtime, no record_export, no update_scenario_last_run_summary, no db.add / db.commit / db.flush / session.add / session.commit.

recommended_next_phase: Phase 51D-1: Apply the same vertical extraction pattern to the next god-module hotspot in main_web.py. Candidate targets (in order of body size, all > 50 non-blank lines): POST /validate (line 1427), POST /scenarios/state/draft (line 2181), POST /scenarios/save (line 2316). For each, the proposed pattern is: (1) characterization phase (e.g. phase5x1_*) — pin current behavior, no production code change; (2) vertical extraction phase (e.g. phase5x2_*) — extract orchestration body into a service module, keep the route thin, write characterization + extraction test suites. /compare and /run will serve as the canonical templates.
